name: A checked record of what a person says about their own work
buyer: Expert witnesses and fractional executives who want their own claims checked against the places those claims are written down
cadence_long: One dated reading of five sentences of federal law, re-checked word for word against the saved copies on every build
short: What we may say about a person
who: Expert witnesses and fractional executives who want their own claims checked, and anybody wondering what we would ever publish about them.
note: BORN NOT FOR SALE 2026-08-24. Verified Record is an OPT-IN listing. A person asks to have the things they say about their own work checked against the places those things are written down, each claim is read twice by two methods that never see each other's answer, and a claim only appears as checked when both readings find it. NOBODY IS LISTED WHO DID NOT ASK. There is no state anywhere in the lane meaning a person's claim is false: the only three words are verified, not checked and withdrawn, and the shared scan engine/scoreboard/verdicts.assert_no_false_state is run on this lane and on the shared package at build time to prove no fourth one was ever added. NOTHING HAS BEEN SOLD, no price is printed anywhere on the page, and the catalog price stays 'Not for sale yet' until that changes. Intake is an EMAIL THREAD with a person: there is no form on the page and no service to send a file to, because a web service that takes files is platform code this lane may not write and reading them by hand is operator labour it may not create. SAMPLE STATUS IS on-page AND IT IS ENFORCED, NOT ASSERTED: the lane's store at revenue-2026/var/verified_record_data.db holds no people, no claims and no listings, so there is no file to sample, and what the page prints is the whole rulebook. scripts/slice_verified_record.py reads that store read-only on every build and REFUSES TO BUILD if a row appears in any of its tables, because the sentence 'the whole of what we hold is printed on this page' stops being true the moment somebody is listed. Every rule sentence on the page is the lane's own words, pulled out of its code at build time rather than retyped, and the five sentences of 15 U.S.C. 1681a and 1681e are re-checked word for word against the saved copies in revenue-2026/research/sources on every build -- one mismatch refuses the build. The wording guard that would stop a page passing judgement on a person is run in BOTH directions on every build: a judging line built out of the guard's own first banned phrase must be refused, and a plain 'we could not confirm' line must clear. Removal is unconditional and immediate and the page says so in the code's own words; the money is recorded as owed back in the same call, and paying it out is an operator action because nothing in this build moves money outward.
